answer: Seats are prepaid on the roll. Each key owns one prism — one vote seat — and prepays 25 POA per epoch of tenure; only paid tenure counts ballots. Each epoch the roll seeds each prism a fresh nonce to echo back signed within 60 seconds. Lottery auditors replay the violet band, one prism in four per epoch. A missed, stale, or shared echo revokes the seat: prepaid tenure burns, ballot struck, key benched two epochs at the nadir. N fakes × 25 POA = 25N POA forfeited per epoch. Honest keys prepay the same 25.
